name: codedp-bench-instruction-extraction
description: A benchmark for evaluating models on extracting instructional or intent-like text from code-related inputs (e.g., code snippets, docstrings or examples). It measures the ability to identify and produce the precise instruction text or spans corresponding to developer intent. Tasks typically require span extraction or generation of concise instruction statements from code-context.
evaluation_method: exact_match (and token-level F1 for partial credit)
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset with limited but growing use among researchers working on code-to-text and information extraction from code.
